verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a button beside the commit message field that can suggest messages using AI. Those suggestions are generated by sending the staged differences to OpenAI, which matches the story directly, and the homepage lists commit suggestions as an opt-in feature. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality, deeper documentation of the feature (configuration, model choice, how suggestions are presented or edited).

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated commit message suggestions based on my staged changes

citations.quote: The small button at the left of the commit message field shows a list of previous messages and includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence.
These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
